fit_rationale: Fit Score: 5.2/10 - Candidate demonstrates strong design fundamentals with solid Figma proficiency, accessibility knowledge, and stakeholder communication skills honed through senior legal work. However, critical baseline experience gap exists: the role requires minimum 3 years professional UX/UI experience but candidate has only 2.1 years (1.3 years contract + 0.4 years part-time internship + pro bono work). Strong differentiator gaps in design systems contribution and front-end collaboration. Remaining statutory requirements are procedural only.

requirements.requirement_text: Portfolio: A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX/UI work across web and mobile platforms. We want to see your process (research → ideation → testing → iteration), not just final screens.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate led full end-to-end UX for a council portal—from stakeholder workshops through to developer handoff—demonstrating the research-to-delivery process the role demands.

requirements.requirement_text: Tools: Advanced proficiency in Figma (including component libraries, auto layout, variables, and Dev Mode). Experience with prototyping and user testing tools (e.g., Maze, UserTesting, Optimal Workshop).
requirements.evidence_source: candidate_profile.skills.technical_skills[] (Figma daily use 2+ years; Maze, UserTesting listed—but no evidence of advanced Figma features: component libraries, auto layout, variables, Dev Mode)

requirements.requirement_text: Research Skills: Demonstrated experience planning and conducting user research, and translating findings into design decisions. We value designers who can run their own research, not just consume research reports.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate independently planned and conducted user research for a pro bono community project (15 participants) and ran competitive analysis/heuristic evaluations on client work—demonstrating autonomous research capability, not just passive research consumption.

requirements.requirement_text: Accessibility: Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA standards and inclusive design principles, with evidence of applying them in shipped products.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate holds formal accessibility certification from Interaction Design Foundation and lists WCAG 2.1 AA as a core competency—demonstrating structured accessibility knowledge beyond theoretical awareness.

evidence_downgrade.reason: Accessibility certification shows knowledge but not application in shipped products as required.

requirements.requirement_text: Collaboration: Proven ability to work effectively within Agile squads, including constructive collaboration with product managers, engineers, and content designers.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate demonstrates Agile/Scrum tooling (Jira) and brings transferable cross-functional collaboration from senior legal work—managing teams, coordinating with stakeholders across borders under high-pressure timelines.

requirements.requirement_text: Communication: Ability to articulate design rationale clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including at senior leadership level.
requirements.strength_note: Candidate brings senior-level stakeholder communication skills from legal advisory role—translating complex concepts into plain-English advice for C-suite clients—a directly transferable strength for articulating design rationale to GM-level stakeholders.

requirements.requirement_text: Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional UX/UI design experience (agency, in-house, or contract). Financial services, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience is highly regarded but not essential.
requirements.evidence_source: candidate_profile.work_history[] (1.3 years contract UX Designer at Bright Pixel Studio + 0.4 years part-time UX Design Intern at Neighbourhood Digital = 1.7 years professional UX experience; pro bono work is non-commercial)
